item.title: STL looks to data centers for growth
item.description: Driven by AI and hyperscaler demand, STL is pivoting toward data center interconnects, a segment that optical networking business CEO Rahul Puri believes could create 'one more STL' in the coming years.

item.title: NXP to exit 5G with closure of radio power fab in Arizona
item.description: Worsening conditions in 5G and 'no outlook for recovery' have prompted NXP to quit the 5G market for power amplifiers.

item.title: Eurobites: Deutsche Telekom hooks up with OpenAI
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: MasOrange, Ericsson trial 'intelligent automation'; Vodafone goes with Spirent for 5G updates; GSMA calls for 'smarter' spectrum policies.

item.title: Why Amazon Leo and AST SpaceMobile matter in a Starlink world
item.description: Roger Entner explores 'the deliberate, expensive and strategic effort by the world's largest telecom companies to prevent a SpaceX monopoly.'

item.title: What's the state of play for CBRS?
item.description: Dave Wright of Spectrum for the Future and Jason Wallin with the OnGo Alliance discuss how CBRS might be impacted as the FCC and NTIA look high and low for spectrum. They also explain whether the band is under siege or only mildly threatened.

item.title: Comcast launches national pricing and packaging for video
item.description: Echoing an approach it recently took with broadband, Comcast has debuted a handful of national, no-contract video packages that feature bundle discounts, more cloud DVR storage and features Comcast's X1 4K TV box.

item.title: Starlink inks multi-year agreement with NetJets
item.description: New partnership will see SpaceX's Starlink bring in-flight connectivity to 600 aircraft across NetJets' global fleet by the end of 2026. #pressrelease

item.title: India's PC market surges in Q3 – Omdia
item.description: The latest research from Omdia reveals that India's PC market (excluding tablets) posted its strongest quarterly performance on record. #pressrelease

item.title: Plume connects with the Connectivity Standards Alliance
item.description: Plume has joined the Connectivity Standards Alliance as a participant member amid ongoing focus on interoperability. #pressrelease

item.title: Astound launches fixed wireless to California communities
item.description: Astound said it has launched a fixed wireless network covering more than 26,000 homes in Davis and the Yolo and Placer counties in California. The rollout includes more than 2,000 homes in rural areas that lacked high-speed Internet service. #pressrelease
